about: The Ed25519 public keys the launcher trusts for release manifests (docs/RELEASE_SIGNING.md). Each: id (the first 16 hex digits of the key's SHA-256), ed25519 (the 32-byte key, base64), added, note; a revoked key is kept with "revoked": true. Empty until the owner generates the release key (tools/release.py keygen): until then every update is refused.
